answer: One workable design: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because comet only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, ivory is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any trellis approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
